adataviz.pl.scatter module¶

Embedding scatter plots: plot_categorical and plot_gene.

These wrap the lower-level helpers in adataviz.utils (the categorical_scatter / continuous_scatter engines) so that they can be used directly from adataviz.pl with palette resolution from adata.uns and a consistent legend_kws interface.

plot_gene is now scoped to the embedding plot only; for box / strip / violin plots of single genes use adataviz.pl.boxplot() or adataviz.pl.stacked_violinplot().

adataviz.pl.scatter.assign_default_colors(adata, key: str) → dict[source]¶

Assign default categorical colours for adata.obs[key].

Mirrors scanpy’s palette logic, writes the result to adata.uns[f"{key}_colors"] and returns a {cat: hex} dict.

adataviz.pl.scatter.plot_categorical(adata, ax=None, basis: str = 'umap', groupby: str = 'Subclass', coding: bool = True, coded_marker: bool = True, save: str | None = None, palette=None, sheet_name: str | None = None, show: bool = True, figsize=(4, 3.5), ncol: int | None = None, fontsize: int = 5, legend_fontsize: int = 5, legend_kws: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, legend_title_fontsize: int = 5, marker_fontsize: int = 4, marker_pad: float = 0.1, linewidth: float = 0.5, axis_format: str = 'tiny', alpha: float = 0.7, text_kws: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs)[source]¶

Categorical scatter on an embedding (e.g. UMAP) coloured by groupby.

Resolves colours from (in order) palette arg, adata.uns[<groupby>_colors], or a generated default palette. legend_kws is forwarded to the legend.

adataviz.pl.scatter.plot_gene(adata, gene: str, basis: str = 'umap', obs=None, query_str: str | None = None, title: str | None = None, cmap: str = 'parula', hue_norm=None, cbar_kws=None, axis_format: str = 'tiny', obsm=None, normalize_per_cell: bool = False, hypo_score: bool = False, clip_norm_value: float = 10, figsize=(4, 4), ax=None, save: str | None = None, show: bool = True, scatter_kws: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None)[source]¶

Plot a single gene’s expression on an embedding.

The previous plot_gene produced both a scatter and a per-group violin/box plot. The violin/box behaviour now lives in adataviz.pl.boxplot(); this function is purely about the embedding visualisation.

Parameters:

  • adata (AnnData or path) – Source data.

  • gene (str) – Gene name (must exist in adata.var_names).

  • basis (str, default "umap") – Embedding key in adata.obsm (without X_ prefix).

  • obs (optional) – Override metadata or alternative embeddings (path or AnnData).

  • obsm (optional) – Override metadata or alternative embeddings (path or AnnData).
